findings.title: FG-IR-26-180: Arbitrary file write in grpc phQueryMaster (FortiSIEM, CVE-2026-106173)
findings.summary_md: Fortinet's advisory for CVE-2026-106173 describes a CWE-22 path traversal in FortiSIEM allowing an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specially crafted packets, scored CVSS 9.4 with Known Exploited marked No. Only FortiSIEM 7.5.0 is affected; the fix is 7.5.1 or above, and the stated workaround is restricting access on tcp port 27918. FortiSIEM Cloud is not affected. The page lists the timeline as initial publication 2026-10-13 (date only, no time stated).

findings.title: FG-IR-26-185: Improper access control and session management in the web management interface (FortiSandbox, CVE-2026-107656)
findings.summary_md: Fortinet's advisory for CVE-2026-107656 describes a CWE-288 authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel in the FortiSandbox GUI, allowing a remote unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication via crafted HTTP requests, scored CVSS 9.6 with Known Exploited marked No. Affected versions are FortiSandbox 5.0.0 through 5.0.6 (fix 5.0.7) and 4.4.0 through 4.4.9 (fix 4.4.10); 5.2 is not affected, and FortiSandbox PaaS 4.4 has all versions affected with guidance to migrate to a fixed release. The page lists initial publication 2026-10-13 (date only, no time stated).

findings.title: Fortinet security advisory (AV26-1037) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
findings.summary_md: The Canadian Centre for Cyber Security issued rollup advisory AV26-1037 dated October 13, 2026 listing affected branches across the Fortinet line: FortiAnalyzer prior to 7.6.5 and 7.4.8, FortiManager prior to 7.6.5 and 7.4.7, FortiMail prior to 7.6.4, 7.4.6, and 7.2.9, FortiSIEM prior to 7.5.1, and FortiSandbox prior to 4.4.10 and 5.0.7, with FortiSandbox PaaS 4.4 entirely affected. It names flaw classes including arbitrary file read and write via SQL injection, a file write in grpc phQueryMaster, SQL command injection in webmail, and improper access control and session management in a web management interface. Page metadata confirms 2026-10-13 (date only, no time stated).
